findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice mcqs for Chapter 9 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 124 questions numbered 1-124; by section: 9.1 16, 9.2 8, 9.3 9, 9.4 11, 9.5 13, 9.6 10, 9.7 13, 9.8 17, 9.8~2 9, 9.9 18. Keys: {'a': 31, 'b': 31, 'c': 31, 'd': 31}.

Covers every section 9.1-9.9 in order (including the salt hydrolysis section printed as a second 9.8); numericals use values changed from the book's sample problems and were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed: NH₄⁺ is the conjugate acid of NH₃, Kw = Kc[H₂O] = 10⁻¹⁴, Table 9.2 powers are 10⁻¹⁴, [H⁺] = 10⁻ᵖᴴ, Ka = x²/(C − x), KClO₃ gives ClO₃⁻, PbSO₄ Ksp = 1.6 × 10⁻⁸, solubilities in mol dm⁻³, Ca(OH)₂ gives S and 2S, methyl orange is red in acid. The misprinted Ka values of Table 9.3 and the Kw value at 100 °C are not used.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
